# UIT-VSMEC manual drop

Official source folder: `https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HooABJyrddVGzll7fgkJ6VzkG_XuWfRu?usp=drive_link`

Place the official test workbook `test_nor_811.xlsx` in this directory. The normalizer writes `data/processed/external/uit_vsmec/test.csv` with columns `sample_id,text,emotion`. The source workbook's first-column identifiers repeat, so stable row-based sample IDs are generated without deduplicating records.

Keep the author-contact permission evidence privately. Do not substitute an unsplit mirror or a random split.
